notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
Each character has a front (with the Personal Goal) and a back (after the card is flipped, with the new ability). 'upper' and 'lower' are the paragraphs above and below the divider line.
Jyn Erso-2 back keeps the printed double space in 'a patrol  within' (owner confirmed).
IG-88 has the droid icon printed after the name: the name is stored as 'IG-88 {DROID}'.
Setup text is the printed 'Setup:' line without the label. Two red dots and yellow dashes on the card art are decorative and not transcribed.
